parsed.explanation: Combined regime: the national framework sets the operative rules inside this national-seat jurisdiction. Documented universal or near-universal exposures include the passport sex-marker restriction (in force since Nov 2025), entry refusal and possible lifetime fraud ineligibility for document discrepancies, and a facilities ban attached by the national legislature (scope unsourced). Custody harms are documented in national immigration custody and national corrections policy. Trespass arrests and the 5 Dec 2024 arrests at the legislature show state enforcement against trans people and advocacy. Local factors cut the other way only modestly: no local bathroom ban, and a July 2026 low-risk placement that is explicitly non-durable because national action can override it. No local hate-crime enforcement, custody, or marker-process evidence is documented, so those are not credited. Net: elevated-to-high exposure, with severity concentrated in custody and entry.

entry_documents.exposure: Passport sex-marker restriction in effect; entry cable requires refusal on document discrepancy and allows lifetime fraud-ineligibility consideration; foreign advisories issued.
entry_documents.protection: Not documented for visitors; X-marker passports valid until expiry.
entry_documents.interaction: National entry and passport rules apply directly in this national-seat territory; local status does not alter them.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody: documented forced labour, beatings, solitary confinement and severe sexual abuse of transgender men. National corrections policy mandates conversion-style measures and care denial from 2026.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented as operating for trans detainees.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Detention under national authority; trespass arrests (national-attached bathroom ban) show detention possible on facilities use.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Facilities ban attached by national legislature applies within this territory; scope, buildings covered and whether it reaches visitors are not sourced. Trespass offence exists in other states under the same national pattern.
federal_state_facilities.protection: This jurisdiction has no local bathroom ban of its own; local law is credited only as far as it survives national override.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Local permissiveness is subordinate to a national-legislature ban that the local council cannot repeal.

care_services.exposure: National hospital subpoenas for records of under-19 patients; proposed rules to bar public insurance reimbursement for minors; LGBTQ youth crisis services shut down.
care_services.interaction: Federal funding and records demands reach facilities regardless of local status.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National counterterrorism strategy names 'radically pro-transgender' groups as targets; reward system for leadership arrests; 'radical gender ideology' appears in the December 2025 memorandum; activist arrests on 5 Dec 2024.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Strategy states powers will not target people who merely disagree; not operative for trans people.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: National threat-framing applies inside the territory; local low-risk ranking does not reach it.

minors_guardians.exposure: Executive order directs investigation of schools and prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition, including preferred names; care bans for minors in 27 states; hospital records subpoenas for minors.
minors_guardians.protection: Not documented as operating for minors locally.
minors_guardians.interaction: A travelling minor's guardian faces records and school-facing exposure; national orders may be enjoined but remain in force until changed.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Not documented locally for trans visitors; the national hate-crime statute covers gender identity, but enforcement is not evidenced here.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; 22 state/provinces protect against discrimination (not this one as documented).
street_violence_police_response.interaction: No local police or violence record is sourced.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport and facilities challenges are unresolved; local marker-change procedure, local hate-crime enforcement and local custody conditions are not documented; scope of the attached ban is unknown.
remedies_unknowns.protection: The July 2026 low-risk placement is credited only as a non-durable ranking; its method is unverifiable.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Outcomes depend on which national measures are in effect at the time of travel.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: universal entry exclusion for visibly trans travellers with no effective appeal. This case is less severe on entry because refusal is discrepancy-based rather than presentation-based, and it adds no equivalent routine discretionary exclusion regime.

Similar: universal registration-type exposure and document-linked harms with no imprisonment. This case is comparable on documents but adds documented custody abuse and national enforcement against advocacy, so it sits somewhat lower.

Lower-similar: birth-sex housing and assault in custody, with conversion-style measures documented. This case has no documented capital pathway and a local protective ranking, so it is higher than 0.25-C but below 0.45.

Lower: 0.55-B has administrative-only denial and no documented custody abuse or national enforcement against advocates. This case has documented detention harms and national threat-framing, so it sits clearly below.

parsed.synthesis: Universal document and entry exposure from national rules applies to every trans traveller in this territory. Custody harms are documented in the national system that holds detained travellers. The national-legislature facilities ban overrides local protective law, and its scope is unsourced. A July 2026 low-risk placement is weakened by its own caveat that national action can override it. Local protections are real but not documented as operating for visitors, and the remaining local gaps are not credited. Documented exposures therefore outweigh the local mitigation.
